title: Lester Young the carefree country boy
summary: Procope remembers Lester walking New York with his saxophone under his arm without a case, before he returned with Count Basie.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: So did you get to know Lester then?
Oh, Lester was a big, carefree country boy. He used to walk around New York with his saxophone under

his arm, in no case. So I told him, you know, I'd say, "Hey, man, you've got to get a case for that horn. Nobody under walks around with a horn / his arm." You know. Without a case. And he -- you know, and he was a funny fellow, because the expressions he used to use and the things that were funny to him, and just his habits in general. He was just a big country boy, you know. But I guess then he went back to Kansas City, and lo and behold the next time he showed up with Count Basie and that was it.
See, because it was a different setting.
